hero.headline: Industrial Networking
hero.description: SILBO delivers rugged routers, gateways, and switches purpose-built for telecom, industrial IoT, and mission-critical edge connectivity.

latestLaunch.highlight: Dual 5G modems, 6× GbE ports, Intel X7425E — our highest-performance SD-WAN router, built for bandwidth-critical enterprise and telecom deployments.

intelSection.heading: Intel-Powered
intelSection.description: x86 architecture at the industrial edge — full Ubuntu, Windows, or OpenWRT support with integrated 5G and Wi-Fi 6.

items.title: Telecom Tower Backhaul
items.desc: Purpose-built -48V routers and gateways for tower site connectivity with dual-SIM failover and remote NMS management.

items.title: SD-WAN & Enterprise WAN
items.desc: Intel-based SD-WAN routers with centralised control, traffic prioritisation, and zero-touch provisioning for distributed networks.

items.title: Industrial IoT Edge
items.desc: Gateways with RS485, RS232, DIO, and AI inputs for legacy equipment integration and factory-floor data collection.

items.title: Remote & Harsh Environments
items.desc: IP66/IP67-rated outdoor routers and ODUs for oil, gas, utilities, and solar sites with extreme temperature and weather conditions.

partners.heading: Built on
partners.description: SILBO products are engineered in collaboration with leading semiconductor partners — combining best-in-class compute, connectivity, and networking silicon.

ctaBanner.heading: Ready to connect your infrastructure?
ctaBanner.description: Talk to our team about the right SILBO device for your deployment.
